name: retro-grid
title: Retro Grid
description: An animated scrolling retro grid effect, rendered with WebGL and a CSS fallback.

props.name: angle
props.description: Tilt of the grid in degrees (1–89).

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Size of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: lightLineColor
props.description: Line colour in light mode (any CSS colour).

props.name: darkLineColor
props.description: Line colour in dark mode (any CSS colour).
